events.what: Miyaoka proves Chern's conjecture for closed proper Dupin hypersurfaces with constant mean curvature (g=3; g=4 with constant scalar or Lie curvature; g=6 with constant Lie curvature)
Ge, Tan, Yan, Zhang: approximate verification of the second-gap version for minimal Willmore hypersurfaces, a curvature bound weaker than conjectured
Tao: isoparametric rigidity for minimal CSC hypersurfaces in S^6 under constancy hypotheses on principal-curvature functions
Ge, Liu, Luo, Yan: case of 4-dimensional minimal hypersurfaces in S^5 with constant Gauss-Kronecker curvature
Tan, Tang, Xie, Yan: discreteness of scalar-curvature values under an added constant cubic trace hypothesis
events.ai_basis: we used ChatGPT 5.6 Sol to interpret relevant literature and mathematical tools ... All mathematical arguments and proofs were independently developed and verified by the authors

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. All events are restricted cases or bounds; none is whole. The ai.basis_quote comes from 2609.03711, not from Miyaoka's paper, which the record says mentions no AI. It supports only literature interpretation, so ai_role none holds for every event. The cubic-trace discreteness result may be closer to a variant or bound than a case, but that does not change the tier.

corrections.why: F8/F9: the basis quote belongs to Tan–Tang–Xie–Yan (2609.03711), not to Miyaoka's paper that the status rests on (the record says Miyaoka's paper mentions no AI). In any case the quote shows ChatGPT used only to interpret the literature, which is none.
